messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [Support] BlueStream - request to preserve short-term payloads for live investigation

Hi Kim / Vivek —

We're in the middle of a live customer investigation with BlueStream (ticket BS-4987). Their environment is hitting a rare decode failure that only reproduces on ~2% of requests. To reproduce, we need a retained set of full request payloads and KV cache snapshots for a 48-hour window starting now.

Normally retention is 24 hours for debug-level artifacts for hosted customers in the US region; BlueStream has asked us to extend retention for this case to capture the repro. They've signed a minimal scope form (attached) and we have the incident summary from the on-call path (attached).

Ask: Can we get an approved short-term retention waiver to preserve the specified artifacts for 48 hours? If approved, the access will be limited to the SRE/support team (Dylan, Marissa) and a named BlueStream engineer (Samir). We'll record all access in the audit log and produce a deletion confirmation when the window closes.

Risk controls I plan to apply if approved:
- Only the related request IDs and cache keys will be exported; nothing else from the tenant.
- Exports stored encrypted with customer-specific KMS key and retained only for the approved window.
- Audit entries for every access; logs to be forwarded to Security for review.

Attachments: bluestream_incident_summary.pdf, redwood_temp_access_form.docx

Thanks — will circle back with any approvals to proceed.

—Dylan
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Kim —

Thanks for flagging. Legal/privacy here. Quick checklist before I can sign off: 
1) Confirm BlueStream has completed and returned the redwood_temp_access_form.docx with an explicit scope (request IDs or timeframe).
2) Confirm the export will be encrypted with the customer's KMS key and that the key policy restricts decryption to named support SAs.
3) A hard deletion job must run at the end of the 48-hour window with a deletion receipt emailed to security@redwood.ai and to BlueStream ops. Receipt must include checksums and the list of request IDs removed.
4) No backups or snapshots of the exported files may be retained in any long-term backup; if any backup store was used for transit, that store must also be purged and receipt provided.

If the above are true, I can approve a 48-hour waiver for this specific scope and require an incident post-mortem that calls out whether the preserved artifacts contained PII. If PII is present, follow our PII handling playbook and notify the customer privacy contact.

Please confirm and paste the signed scope into the ticket thread so we have evidence.

—Lauren
Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
